name: dairy-campus-research-metadata
title: Dairy Campus Research Data Platform: Standardized Data Dictionaries
description: Comprehensive FAIR metadata dictionaries, variables, and schema descriptions for dairy cattle sensor and experimental data collected at Dairy Campus (Wageningen University & Research).

resources.name: tvl_total
resources.description: Comprehensive daily summary per cow integrating all individual data sources: animal demographics, lactation stage, roughage intake (fractions 1-4, fresh and water-excluded), dry matter intake, concentrate intake across stations, morning/evening milk production, official milk test recording components (fat, protein, lactose, urea, SCC), body condition score (BCS), GreenFeed visits, and live body weight.
